$comment: ACE-Framework enforced hooks adapter for Claude Code (v2.7). Installed to .claude/settings.json by `create-ace-framework --adapter claude-code`. PreToolUse blocks edits to regression-guarded files; Stop runs the verify gate before the agent may finish. Windows note: the upstream template invokes the scripts with bare `sh`, which is not on PATH here, so the commands point at Git for Windows' sh.exe. On macOS/Linux change both back to `sh <script>`.
